Powers the liver's T4 to T3 conversion pathway. Your liver needs selenium to build the enzymes that activate your thyroid hormone. 200mcg is the optimal therapeutic dose.

Clinical-grade methylcobalamin. A 2025 Nature Communications study found it directly protects liver cells from inflammatory damage and promotes liver tissue survival. Supports the liver pathway that converts your medication into the active hormone your follicles need.

Magnesium (50mg)
Required for over 300 enzymatic reactions including thyroid hormone production and T4 to T3 conversion.

Copper (1mg)
Works synergistically with zinc for optimal thyroid receptor sensitivity. Proper copper-zinc balance is crucial.

Manganese (2mg)
Supports thyroid hormone synthesis and protects against oxidative stress that damages thyroid tissue.

Vitamin D3 (1000 IU)
Modulates immune function and reduces thyroid antibodies in autoimmune conditions like Hashimoto's.
